title: To Eat / To Work
context: I eat rice and beans at home.
You work at the bank and I work with you.
We work at the office together.
grammar: Present Simple with I, you and we keeps the base verb: I eat, you work, we eat. Use at for workplaces (at the bank, at the office); with for company (with you), and together for shared action. The identifies a specific place.
grammarExamples: We eat rice and beans at home.
We work at the office together.
express: Eu como queijo em casa.
I eat cheese at home.
Você come maçãs no escritório.
You eat apples at the office.
Nós comemos arroz e feijão todos os dias.
We eat rice and beans every day.
Eu como pão e manteiga e bebo café todos os dias.
I eat bread and butter and drink coffee every day.
Você come pão e queijo e bebe café e leite.
You eat bread and cheese and drink coffee and milk.
Eu trabalho na loja.
I work at the store.
Você trabalha no banco.
You work at the bank.
Eu como arroz e feijão em casa.
I eat rice and beans at home.
gaps: We eat rice and ___ at home.

title: To Play / To Like
context: I like to play the guitar.
We play games with my friends.
I don't like to study math.
You like to play fantasy games.
I play the guitar with my brother.
grammar: My and your show possession. Use like + to + base verb to express interests: I like to play. Use the with a named musical instrument: play the guitar. The source also introduces don't as a negative chunk; more detailed negative Present Simple practice comes later in Lesson 10.
grammarExamples: I like to play the guitar.
I play the guitar with my brother.
express: Eu jogo jogos com meu irmão.
I play games with my brother.
Você não gosta de jogos.
You don't like games.
Nós gostamos de tocar violão.
We like to play the guitar.
Você brinca com meu irmão em casa.
You play with my brother at home.
Você não gosta de beber chá. Eu gosto de beber café.
You don't like to drink tea. I like to drink coffee.
Eu brinco no parque com meu irmão.
I play in the park with my brother.
Você gosta de brincar com animais.
You like to play with animals.
Eu não toco violão. Eu toco flauta.
I don't play the guitar. I play the flute.

title: To Read / To Write
context: I read a magazine every week.
He writes a letter at home.
I write a story every week.
He reads articles in the library.
grammar: Present Simple: with he and she, regular verbs normally add -s (he reads, she writes). With I, use the base form (I read, I write). Use a before consonant sounds (a book), an before vowel sounds (an email). In the library gives a location.
grammarExamples: I write a story every week.
express: Ele lê um livro.
He reads a book.
Ela escreve um email.
She writes an email.
Eu leio uma revista toda semana.
I read a magazine every week.
Ele escreve uma carta em casa.
He writes a letter at home.
Ela lê um jornal.
She reads a newspaper.
Ela bebe café e eu bebo chá.
She drinks coffee and I drink tea.
Ele come pão e ela gosta de maçãs.
He eats bread and she likes apples.
Ela escreve com uma caneta.
She writes with a pen.

title: To Cook / To Clean
context: They clean the house on weekends.
We cook dinner in the evening.
I clean my room on Tuesdays.
They cook soup in the kitchen.
You clean the garden in the afternoon.
grammar: With they, we, you and I, use the base verb in Present Simple: They cook; I clean. Use every before a day for a repeated routine (every Monday), on with days (on Tuesdays), and in with parts of the day (in the evening).
grammarExamples: I clean my room on Tuesdays.
We cook dinner in the evening.
express: Eles cozinham o café da manhã.
They cook breakfast.
Eu limpo a cozinha à tarde.
I clean the kitchen in the afternoon.
Você cozinha o almoço todos os dias.
You cook lunch every day.
Eles limpam a casa nos fins de semana.
They clean the house on weekends.
Nós cozinhamos o jantar.
We cook dinner.
Eu limpo meu quarto todos às segundas.
I clean my room on Mondays.
Eles cozinham sopa na cozinha.
They cook soup in the kitchen.
Você limpa o jardim de manhã.
You clean the garden in the morning.

title: To Watch / To Listen
context: They watch podcasts on the platform.
We watch videos on the screen.
You listen to the podcast on the computer.
I watch movies in the theater.
grammar: Watch is followed directly by the thing watched: watch TV, watch movies. Listen uses to before its object: listen to music, listen to us. At introduces an exact time (at 7pm), on often indicates a platform or screen, and in identifies a location.
express: Nós assistimos filmes à noite.
We watch movies at night.
Eu escuto música.
I listen to music.
Você assiste TV às 7 da manhã.
You watch TV at 7am.
Você nos escuta.
You listen to us.
Eles assistem shows na TV.
They watch shows on TV.
Eu escuto podcasts na internet.
I listen to podcasts on the internet.
Nós assistimos vídeos na tela.
We watch videos on the screen.
Você escuta o podcast no aplicativo.
You listen to the podcast on the app.

title: To Be · Am / Is / Are
context: He is a doctor at the hospital.
She is happy because she has a new book.
I am hungry. I want an apple.
grammar: This lesson introduces To Be: I am; he, she, it is; you, we, they are. Use it to identify a person, describe a state, or locate someone. This is Subject + Be + Complement, not always Subject + Verb + Object. A/an accompany singular professions; but contrasts, because explains a reason.
express: Eu sou um estudante.
I am a student.
Ele é um médico no hospital.
He is a doctor at the hospital.
Nós estamos em casa.
We are at home.
Ela está feliz porque tem um livro novo.
She is happy because she has a new book.
Eles estão cansados mas animados.
They are tired but excited.
Eu estou com fome. Eu quero uma maçã.
I am hungry. I want an apple.
Você é meu amigo.
You are my friend.
choose: She is happy ___ she has a book.

title: To Be · Negative
context: They are not at the beach.
It is not a café; it is a restaurant.
You are not angry, you are just tired.
This is my book, but that is not my pen.
He is not sick, but he is cold.
chunks: They are not at the beach
grammar: Form To Be negative by adding not after be: I am not, she is not / isn't, they are not / aren't. Do not use do or does with be. This and that identify objects nearby or farther away. Contrast two ideas with but.
express: Eu não sou um advogado.
I am not a lawyer.
Ela não é uma artista.
She is not an artist.
Eles não estão na praia.
They are not at the beach.
Isto não é um café; é um restaurante.
This is not a café; it is a restaurant.
Você não está com raiva, está apenas cansado.
You are not angry; you are just tired.
Este é meu livro, mas aquele não é minha caneta.
This is my book, but that is not my pen.
Ele não está doente, mas está com frio.
He is not sick, but he is cold.
choose: ___ is my book; that is not.
